verses.original: Οἴδαμεν γὰρ ὅτι ἐὰν ἡ ἐπίγειος ἡμῶν οἰκία τοῦ σκήνους καταλυθῇ οἰκοδομὴν ἐκ Θεοῦ ἔχομεν οἰκίαν ἀχειροποίητον αἰώνιον ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς
verses.transliteration: Oidamen gar hoti ean hē epigeios hēmōn oikia tou skēnous katalythē oikodomēn ek Theou echomen oikian acheiropoiēton aiōnion en tois ouranois
verses.literal: For we know that if the earthly tent we live in is dismantled we have a building from God an eternal house in heaven not built by human hands

verses.original: καὶ γὰρ ἐν τούτῳ στενάζομεν τὸ οἰκητήριον ἡμῶν τὸ ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἐπενδύσασθαι ἐπιποθοῦντες
verses.transliteration: kai gar en toutō stenazomen to oikētērion hēmōn to ex ouranou ependysasthai epipothountes
verses.literal: For in this tent we groan longing to be clothed with our heavenly dwelling

verses.original: εἴ γε καὶ ἐνδυσάμενοι οὐ γυμνοὶ εὑρεθησόμεθα
verses.transliteration: ei ge kai endysamenoi ou gymnoi heurethēsometha
verses.literal: because . . . . . . when we are clothed we will not be found naked

verses.original: καὶ γὰρ οἱ ὄντες ἐν τῷ σκήνει στενάζομεν βαρούμενοι ἐφ’ ᾧ οὐ θέλομεν ἐκδύσασθαι ἀλλ’ ἐπενδύσασθαι ἵνα καταποθῇ τὸ θνητὸν ὑπὸ τῆς ζωῆς
verses.transliteration: kai gar hoi ontes en tō skēnei stenazomen baroumenoi eph’ hō ou thelomen ekdysasthai all’ ependysasthai hina katapothē to thnēton hypo tēs zōēs
verses.literal: For . . . while we are in this tent we groan under our burdens because . . . we do not wish to be unclothed but clothed so that our mortality may be swallowed up by life

verses.original: ὁ δὲ κατεργασάμενος ἡμᾶς εἰς αὐτὸ τοῦτο Θεός ὁ δοὺς ἡμῖν τὸν ἀρραβῶνα τοῦ Πνεύματος
verses.transliteration: ho de katergasamenos hēmas eis auto touto Theos ho dous hēmin ton arrabōna tou Pneumatos
verses.literal: And it is God who has prepared us for this very purpose and has given us the Spirit as a pledge of what is to come

verses.original: Θαρροῦντες οὖν πάντοτε καὶ εἰδότες ὅτι ἐνδημοῦντες ἐν τῷ σώματι ἐκδημοῦμεν ἀπὸ τοῦ Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: Tharrountes oun pantote kai eidotes hoti endēmountes en tō sōmati ekdēmoumen apo tou Kyriou
verses.literal: Therefore we are always confident although we know that while we are at home in the body we are away from the Lord

verses.original: διὰ πίστεως γὰρ περιπατοῦμεν οὐ διὰ εἴδους
verses.transliteration: dia pisteōs gar peripatoumen ou dia eidous
verses.literal: For we walk by faith not by sight

verses.original: Θαρροῦμεν δὲ καὶ εὐδοκοῦμεν μᾶλλον ἐκδημῆσαι ἐκ τοῦ σώματος καὶ ἐνδημῆσαι πρὸς τὸν Κύριον
verses.transliteration: Tharroumen de kai eudokoumen mallon ekdēmēsai ek tou sōmatos kai endēmēsai pros ton Kyrion
verses.literal: We are confident then and would prefer . . . to be away from the body and at home with the Lord

verses.original: διὸ καὶ φιλοτιμούμεθα εἴτε ἐνδημοῦντες εἴτε ἐκδημοῦντες εὐάρεστοι αὐτῷ εἶναι
verses.transliteration: dio kai philotimoumetha eite endēmountes eite ekdēmountes euarestoi autō einai
verses.literal: So we aspire to please Him whether we are at home in this body or away from it

verses.original: τοὺς γὰρ πάντας ἡμᾶς φανερωθῆναι δεῖ ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ βήματος τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἵνα κομίσηται ἕκαστος τὰ διὰ τοῦ σώματος πρὸς ἃ ἔπραξεν εἴτε ἀγαθὸν εἴτε φαῦλον
verses.transliteration: tous gar pantas hēmas phanerōthēnai dei emprosthen tou bēmatos tou Christou hina komisētai hekastos ta dia tou sōmatos pros ha epraxen eite agathon eite phaulon
verses.literal: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive his due for the things done in the body whether good or bad

verses.original: Εἰδότες οὖν τὸν φόβον τοῦ Κυρίου ἀνθρώπους πείθομεν Θεῷ δὲ πεφανερώμεθα ἐλπίζω δὲ καὶ ἐν ταῖς συνειδήσεσιν ὑμῶν πεφανερῶσθαι
verses.transliteration: Eidotes oun ton phobon tou Kyriou anthrōpous peithomen Theō de pephanerōmetha elpizō de kai en tais syneidēsesin hymōn pephanerōsthai
verses.literal: Therefore since we know what it means to fear the Lord we try to persuade men What we are is clear to God and I hope it is clear to your conscience as well

verses.original: οὐ πάλιν ἑαυτοὺς συνιστάνομεν ὑμῖν ἀλλὰ ἀφορμὴν διδόντες ὑμῖν καυχήματος ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν ἵνα ἔχητε πρὸς τοὺς ἐν προσώπῳ καυχωμένους καὶ μὴ ἐν καρδίᾳ
verses.transliteration: ou palin heautous synistanomen hymin alla aphormēn didontes hymin kauchēmatos hyper hēmōn hina echēte pros tous en prosōpō kauchōmenous kai mē en kardia
verses.literal: We are not commending ourselves to you again Instead we are giving you an occasion to be proud of us so that you can answer . . . those who take pride in appearances rather than . . . in the heart

verses.original: Εἴτε γὰρ ἐξέστημεν Θεῷ εἴτε σωφρονοῦμεν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Eite gar exestēmen Theō eite sōphronoumen hymin
verses.literal: If we are out of our mind it is for God if we are of sound mind it is for you

verses.original: ἡ γὰρ ἀγάπη τοῦ Χριστοῦ συνέχει ἡμᾶς κρίναντας τοῦτο ὅτι εἷς ὑπὲρ πάντων ἀπέθανεν ἄρα οἱ πάντες ἀπέθανον
verses.transliteration: hē gar agapē tou Christou synechei hēmas krinantas touto hoti heis hyper pantōn apethanen ara hoi pantes apethanon
verses.literal: For Christ’s love compels us because we are convinced . . . that One died for all therefore all died

verses.original: καὶ ὑπὲρ πάντων ἀπέθανεν ἵνα οἱ ζῶντες μηκέτι ἑαυτοῖς ζῶσιν ἀλλὰ τῷ ὑπὲρ αὐτῶν ἀποθανόντι καὶ ἐγερθέντι
verses.transliteration: kai hyper pantōn apethanen hina hoi zōntes mēketi heautois zōsin alla tō hyper autōn apothanonti kai egerthenti
verses.literal: And He died for all that those who live should no longer live for themselves but for Him who died for them and was raised again

verses.original: Ὥστε ἡμεῖς ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν οὐδένα οἴδαμεν κατὰ σάρκα εἰ καὶ ἐγνώκαμεν κατὰ σάρκα Χριστόν ἀλλὰ νῦν οὐκέτι γινώσκομεν
verses.transliteration: Hōste hēmeis apo tou nyn oudena oidamen kata sarka ei kai egnōkamen kata sarka Christon alla nyn ouketi ginōskomen
verses.literal: So from now on we regard no one according to the flesh Although we once regarded Christ in this way . . . - we do so no longer

verses.original: ὥστε εἴ τις ἐν Χριστῷ καινὴ κτίσις τὰ ἀρχαῖα παρῆλθεν ἰδοὺ γέγονεν καινά
verses.transliteration: hōste ei tis en Christō kainē ktisis ta archaia parēlthen idou gegonen kaina
verses.literal: Therefore if anyone is in Christ he is a new creation The old has passed away Behold the new has come

verses.original: Τὰ δὲ πάντα ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ καταλλάξαντος ἡμᾶς ἑαυτῷ διὰ Χριστοῦ καὶ δόντος ἡμῖν τὴν διακονίαν τῆς καταλλαγῆς
verses.transliteration: Ta de panta ek tou Theou tou katallaxantos hēmas heautō dia Christou kai dontos hēmin tēn diakonian tēs katallagēs
verses.literal: All this is from God who reconciled us to Himself through Christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation

verses.original: ὡς ὅτι Θεὸς ἦν ἐν Χριστῷ κόσμον καταλλάσσων ἑαυτῷ μὴ λογιζόμενος αὐτοῖς τὰ παραπτώματα αὐτῶν καὶ θέμενος ἐν ἡμῖν τὸν λόγον τῆς καταλλαγῆς
verses.transliteration: hōs hoti Theos ēn en Christō kosmon katallassōn heautō mē logizomenos autois ta paraptōmata autōn kai themenos en hēmin ton logon tēs katallagēs
verses.literal: that God was reconciling the world to Himself in Christ not counting men’s trespasses against them And He has committed to us the message of reconciliation

verses.original: Ὑπὲρ Χριστοῦ οὖν πρεσβεύομεν ὡς τοῦ Θεοῦ παρακαλοῦντος δι’ ἡμῶν δεόμεθα ὑπὲρ Χριστοῦ καταλλάγητε τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: Hyper Christou oun presbeuomen hōs tou Theou parakalountos di’ hēmōn deometha hyper Christou katallagēte tō Theō
verses.literal: Therefore we are ambassadors for Christ as though God were making His appeal through us We implore you on behalf of Christ Be reconciled to God

verses.original: τὸν μὴ γνόντα ἁμαρτίαν ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν ἁμαρτίαν ἐποίησεν ἵνα ἡμεῖς γενώμεθα δικαιοσύνη Θεοῦ ἐν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: ton mē gnonta hamartian hyper hēmōn hamartian epoiēsen hina hēmeis genōmetha dikaiosynē Theou en autō
verses.literal: God made Him who knew no sin to be sin on our behalf so that in Him we might become the righteousness of God
